body:
@francoischalifour I see one last thing I think can be improved.

Since the latest fix, we have the following situation:

* if we have no refinements, the showMore/showLess button is hidden. This is perfect 👍
* If I have less refinements than `limit`, the showMore button will not show more items. Similarly, the showLess button will not collapse the few refinements displayed.
  As a results, theses buttons appear to be broken.

![2019-03-01 11 02 42](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2982512/53631205-4ff45000-3c12-11e9-8c60-7d0fdae2459c.gif)

As a user I think it would make more sense that we hide them or disable them. What are your thoughts on that?
